_about: SYNTHETIC test calls. S01–S02 written for this project; S03–S06 are phone versions of real web-form enquiries F03, F05, F08 and F06 from 'Aangan Studio - Enquiry Transcripts, September 2026' (Section 3), using only the details in each form. Same shape as phone_transcripts.json.

transcript: Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm Neha. I have a 2BHK in Baner, about 900 sq ft. Full interiors with execution, done by March.
For a full home we usually work out to about ₹1,800 per sq ft, but the designer will confirm.
Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Haan, mera flat Hinjawadi mein hai, 2BHK, poora interior karwana hai, January tak.
Just to confirm, the flat is in Hinjewadi? Let me pass this to our team so they can confirm — someone will get back to you.
Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm Nilesh Dhamdhere. I found you on Google. I have a 3BHK independent house in Talegaon Dabhade, near Pune, about 1,400 sq ft.
We just got possession and need to do everything from scratch. Timeline is 3 to 4 months, flexible. I know Talegaon is a bit outside Pune — can you still take it up?
Thank you for checking. We only work in Pune city and PCMC, because our contractors need to be on site, so we can't take up a project in Talegaon. I'm sorry.
Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, this is Sheena Menon, Operations Head at NovaSpark Technologies. Our CEO worked with you before — Amey Joshi, on the Innov8 office in Baner.
We just signed the lease on an office in Hinjewadi Phase 1, about 2,200 sq ft, shell and core. We need workstations for 55, four cabins, one boardroom, two meeting rooms, a lounge and a pantry.
That's a full office fitout with design and execution. When do you need it ready?
Operational by January 15. Budget is 60 to 80 lakh all-in, including furniture. Speed matters — we are ready to move fast.
Thank you, I'll pass the budget on to the designer. Would you like to book a free consultation?
Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm Divya Hegde. I have a 2BHK in Wakad, about 875 sq ft. We want the living room and kitchen redone.
We have guests arriving from the US in 3 weeks, so it has to be done in 3 weeks maximum. Budget is 4 to 5 lakh. I know it's urgent.
Design alone takes three to four weeks and execution follows, so we couldn't do it well in three weeks. If you're open to a later finish, we could do it properly. Would that work?
No, it really has to be before they arrive.
Hello, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm Preethi Nair. I read about you in a Pune Mirror article. We have a 4BHK on NIBM Road, ground floor, about 1,950 sq ft. We've lived here five years.
The kitchen needs full replacement, all bedrooms except the master need redoing, the living room needs new flooring and design, and we want to add a proper study.
That's a substantial redesign with execution. When would the site be available?
We're planning to move out temporarily for execution, starting February 2027. Budget is 35 to 40 lakh for this scope, not flexible upward. We've shortlisted three studios.
